stemMd: Which function has a horizontal asymptote y = 2 as x tends to positive infinity?
explanationMd: As positive x becomes large, 1/x approaches zero. Therefore 2 + 1/x approaches two. The other reciprocal approaches zero, while the polynomial choices increase without bound.
